automation.notification_policy: quiet unless milestone, error, report, completion or decision

engineering_attempts.phase: CPU preparation before latest GMC-only scope
engineering_attempts.issue: initial selected CPU interpreter lacked scipy
engineering_attempts.resolution: used existing DrivingEditor interpreter without environment install

engineering_attempts.issue: shared Python39 environment lacks pytest; stopped before Torch/GPU
engineering_attempts.resolution: standalone actual installed CUDA test; no environment install

engineering_attempts.issue: restored Adam aliased checkpoint input tensors
engineering_attempts.resolution: deep-copy optimizer load and regression; real GPU golden state proof passed

engineering_attempts.issue: CPU GT and CUDA composite SSIM device mismatch after three exact checkpoint restores
engineering_attempts.resolution: only GT.to(composite.device); original failure directory preserved; post30k_r2 exported actual observed prefix then yielded to StreetCrafter CPU preparation

limits: GT box prior is engineering baseline, not new research contribution
no true shadow mask or edited GT
fixed topology first, clone/prune API supported but not anisotropic split
background Gaussian-center box removal can retain cross-boundary extent/shadows
shared GPU admission cannot replace real runtime validation

rtx3090_assessment.caveat: Polling misses brief peaks; allocator peaks exclude non-PyTorch CUDA use. 30k densification, evaluation/LPIPS and checkpoints must be covered. A sampled or allocator peak below 24 GiB does not certify fit or speed.

GPU_smoke.assessment: 300-step observation only; full new 30k/evaluation and target3090 validation pending

engineering_contract.other_instance_world_tensors_invariance: GPU execution receipt; independent CPU model restore not performed

actor1_engineering_visual_review.json.reviewer: Codex instance_render sub-agent; model visual inspection, no human quality verdict
actor1_engineering_visual_review.json.observed_GT_identity: White/silver Jeep SUV approaching camera and exiting the left border.

sources.pixel_provenance: Actual FP32 render exports converted to PNG by CPU contact generator; native pixel scale 1, no resizing, contrast stretch, generated content, or invented fixture.
sources.independent_review_limit: This visual review reads local PNG pages and the actual remote CPU validation summary. It does not independently reopen the remote raw NPZ arrays or restore the GPU checkpoint.

modules: Actual FP32 exports and real original masks
Native GT / before / after / contribution ROI pages

reported_CPU_contract.other_instance_world_tensors_invariance: GPU execution receipt; independent CPU model restore not performed

common_before.observed: Distant Jeep body is dark and partially transparent, with smeared/banded appearance and road lines visible through the rendered body. GT is much brighter and clearer.
Nearer body has higher coverage but remains dark, blurry, and striped, with soft wheel/bumper edges. Increasing contribution does not establish correct color or texture.

delete.engineering_effect_observed: Rendered target silhouette disappears and every displayed after-target-contribution panel is black. No recognizable complete Jeep copy remains in the deleted position on these 49 views.
delete.residual_observed: A broad light-gray blurred road patch remains near the removed body, especially frames 28-38. Lane-line and asphalt detail are not cleanly reconstructed.

translate.configured_effect: Vehicle-local translation [0.5, 0.0, 0.0] meters; exact transform is supplied by execution/source contract, not recoverable from pixels alone.
translate.engineering_effect_observed: Far-frame shifts are small. Near-frame body and contribution move/change coverage coherently; during left-border exit the visible portion leaves earlier. No separate full old-pose Jeep duplicate is visible.
translate.residual_observed: The same dark, translucent/banded appearance and blurred road remain. No claim of a photoreal translated object follows from the edit effect.

rotate.configured_effect: 30 degrees of vehicle-local yaw; exact axis is supplied by source/math contract, not established solely by visual inspection.
rotate.engineering_effect_observed: Projected body shape and apparent heading change. After contribution is wider and asymmetric with a changed front/side outline, while the original target pose is not left as a separate complete body.
rotate.residual_observed: Near frames 28-36 show stronger fuzzy edges, blur/tail around the body, and smeared banded texture. Road-like lines remain visible across the dark rendered body. No screen-spanning flyaway or unbounded streak is apparent within reviewed views, but mild tails are present.

empty_target.observed: Original actor1 mask, before-target contribution, and after-target contribution panels are black. No edit introduces a target into these empty views; before/after full views look unchanged. Existing light blurred road patch is visible in both.

interpretation_limits: Road-through-body and banding are observed pixel artifacts; this review does not assign them uniquely to static occlusion, local texture leakage, SH direction, or sparse geometry.

Static saved FP32 equality is a CPU validation result; nonedited world-tensor equality is a GPU execution receipt. Those are separate evidence, and full-scene RGB can change through correct occlusion.
300 steps are insufficient to certify convergence, pose-independent texture quality, clean deletion repair, or edit photorealism. No edited GT is available.
The review does not verify checkpoint restoration to the original scene, relighting, unseen viewpoints, or a human quality verdict.

decision.continuation_reason: Actual edits change the intended target with finite paired exports and unchanged static arrays; current appearance artifacts need the originally budgeted convergence run before capacity can be assessed.
decision.quality_followup: After 30k, compare all49 original reconstruction/body-opacity metrics and all native near-target ROI pairs, with special attention to actor1 dark/banded body, rotation tails, and deletion road patch.

root_engineering_smoke_resume_decision_r.reviewer: Codex root engineering decision, not human verdict
root_engineering_smoke_resume_decision_r.reason: Actual rigid edit responses and identity/occlusion contracts work; no observed engineering blocker. Use originally authorized fixed-trajectory 30k budget to evaluate convergence.
retained_problems: Dark translucent vehicles and incomplete texture at 300 steps
Gray blurred road patches and dark residual shadows after deletion
